name: Digital Thermometer (Can Read Fahrenheit)
description:
Digital Thermometer (Fahrenheit & Celsius) – Made in China

High Accuracy & Fast Measurement: Waterproof probe ensures precise readings within ±0.1°C / ±0.2°F. Get results in just 1 minute.

Easy to Use: Clear LCD display with beeping alert indicates when measurement is complete.

Versatile & Convenient: Suitable for oral, rectal, or underarm use. Compact, mini design makes it easy to carry anywhere.

Safe & Reliable: Unbreakable body with automatic shut-off for added safety.

Family-Friendly: Can store temperature data for the whole family with memory function.

Temperature Range: 32–42°C (90–108°F).

Power Source: LR41 button cell battery.
